response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) AS avg_of_avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count FROM (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) t

assumptions.assumption: Track count per media type is the number of tracks meeting the Bytes threshold (COUNT(*)); since Bytes >= threshold excludes NULL Bytes, all counted tracks have non-null Bytes.
Bytes is cast to REAL to avoid integer division; Milliseconds is NOT NULL, and zero values are assumed not to occur.
